```{r}
sidebarLayout(
  sidebarPanel(
    sliderInput("year_range", "Select Year Range:",
                min = min(dataR$Year),
                max = max(dataR$Year),
                value = c(min(dataR$Year), max(dataR$Year)),
                step = 1),
    
    selectInput("region", "Choose a Region:",
                choices = unique(dataR$Type), 
                selected = unique(dataR$Type)[1],
                multiple = TRUE),
    
    selectInput("country", "Choose a Country:",
                choices = unique(dataR$Region), 
                selected = unique(dataR$Region)[1],
                multiple = TRUE), 
    
    downloadButton("download_data", "Download Data")
  ),
  
  mainPanel(
    DTOutput("data_table"),
    valueBoxOutput("highest_score"),
    valueBoxOutput("number_movies"),
    valueBoxOutput("number_production_studio"),
    valueBoxOutput("audience_satisfaction"),
    highchartOutput("scatter_plot"),
    DTOutput("data_table")
  )
)
```

```{r}

output$female_growth_box <- renderValueBox({
  # Filtrer les données en fonction des entrées de l'utilisateur
  filtered_data <- dataR %>%
    filter(Year >= input$year_range[1], Year <= input$year_range[2],
           Type %in% input$region,
           Region %in% input$country)
  
  # Vérifier si les données filtrées ne sont pas vides
  if(nrow(filtered_data) > 0) {
    # Calculer le taux de croissance de la population féminine
    female_growth <- filtered_data %>%
      arrange(Year) %>%
      summarise(
        Female_Start = first(`Female Population(thousands)`),
        Female_End = last(`Female Population(thousands)`)
      ) %>%
      mutate(Growth_Rate = ((Female_End - Female_Start) / Female_Start) * 100)
    
    # Créer une boîte avec le taux de croissance calculé
    valueBox(
      value = paste0(round(female_growth$Growth_Rate, 2), " %"),
      subtitle = "Taux de croissance - Population féminine",
      icon = icon("female"),
      color = ifelse(female_growth$Growth_Rate > 0, "success", "danger")
    )
  } else {
    # Si aucune donnée n'est disponible
    valueBox(
      value = "N/A",
      subtitle = "Taux de croissance - Population féminine",
      icon = icon("female"),
      color = "warning"
    )
  }
})
```

```{r}
# Mise à jour des choix de pays en fonction de la région sélectionnée
observe({
  selected_region <- input$region
  countries <- dataR %>%
    filter(Type == selected_region) %>%
    pull(Region)
  
  updateSelectInput(session, "country", choices = unique(countries), selected = unique(countries)[1], multiple = TRUE)
})
```

### Taux de croissance démographique (%) 

```{r}
output$growth <- renderValueBox({
  growth <- dataR %>%
    filter(Year >= input$year_range[1], Year <= input$year_range[2],
           `Type` == input$region,
           `Country or Area` == input$country) %>%
    summarise(
      Pop_Start = first('Total Population(thousands)', order_by = Year),
      Pop_End = last('Total Population(thousands)', order_by = Year)
    ) %>%
    mutate(Growth_Rate = ((Pop_End - Pop_Start) / Pop_Start) * 100) 

  valueBox(
    paste0(round(growth$Growth_Rate, 2), " %"),
    "Taux de croissance démographique",
    icon = icon("chart-line"),
    color = ifelse(growth$Growth_Rate > 0, "lightgreen", "red")
  )
})

```

### Espérance de vie - Tous sexes

```{r}
output$life_expectancy_both <- renderValueBox({
  life_expectancy_both <- dataR %>%
    filter(Year >= input$year_range[1], Year <= input$year_range[2],
           `Type` == input$region,
           `Country or Area` == input$country) %>%
    summarise(Average_Life_Expectancy = mean(`Life Expectancy at Birth both sexes (years)`, na.rm = TRUE))

  valueBox(
    paste0(round(life_expectancy_both$Average_Life_Expectancy, 1), " ans"),
    "Espérance de vie - Tous sexes",
    icon = icon("heartbeat"),
    color = "lightgreen"
  )
})
```

### Ratio moyen de sexe (Hommes pour  100 femmes)

```{r}

})
```

```{r}
output$scatter_plot <- renderHighchart({
  filtered_data <- data %>%
    filter(Year >= input$year_range[1], Year <= input$year_range[2],
           `Region, subregion, country or area *` == input$region,
           `Country or Area` == input$country)

  highchart() %>%
    hc_add_series(data = filtered_data, type = "scatter", 
                  hcaes(x = Critics_Score, y = Audience_Satisfaction, text = Title)) %>%
    hc_title(text = "Relationship between Critics Score and Audience Satisfaction") %>%
    hc_xAxis(title = list(text = "Critics Score")) %>%
    hc_yAxis(title = list(text = "Audience Satisfaction"))
})
```

```{r}
output$download_data <- downloadHandler(
  filename = function() {
    paste("data_", Sys.Date(), ".csv", sep = "")
  },
  content = function(file) {
    filtered_data <- data %>%
      filter(Year >= input$year_range[1], Year <= input$year_range[2],
             `Region, subregion, country or area *` == input$region,
             `Country or Area` == input$country)
    
    write.csv(filtered_data, file, row.names = FALSE)
  }
)
```
